name: Durango
card: The southwest corner of the state, a different market from the Grand Valley.
near: It is the seat of La Plata County, well south of Grand Junction.
metaTitle: Durango Websites and Local SEO | Nick Perry Digital
metaDescription: Websites and local SEO for Durango and La Plata County. Remote-friendly working relationship, same posted prices, no fake local office.
body:
Durango is not a suburb of Grand Junction. It is the center of La Plata County, with its own tourism season and its own local searches. Treating it as a duplicate of a Grand Valley page wastes the visit.

I work with Durango businesses from the Western Slope without pretending I have a downtown Durango office. Calls, the site, and the listing can all be handled at a distance. If a project needs time on the ground, we will talk about that before the quote.
businesses: Home services in Durango and Bayfield
Retail that serves locals and visitors
extraQ: Durango is far from Grand Junction. Do you still take projects there?
extraA: Yes. The work is mostly on the site, the listing, and the reporting, which do not require me to sit in your office. I will not invent a Durango storefront to make the site look more local than it is.
